content:
Alex Kim: Heads up — we need a short, actionable compliance playbook for the marketplace listing that covers: SOC reports, pen test window, questionnaire flow for SIs, and artifact ingestion/owners. target: internal review by EOD Wed.
Rebecca Liu: +1. can we include SOC2 expiration & scoping notes? I have the attestation PDF but it mentions environment differences for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Mike O'Connor: pen-test window: suggest we offer a 2-week window in May, with 5 business days for remediation verification. who owns scheduling with the 3P vendor?
Sara Patel: I'll take ownership of artifact ingestion & presigned flows. Need the S3 path naming convention and redaction checklist.
Jordan Lee: I'll coordinate SI questionnaire (vendor -> SI -> legal). we should provide a minimal checklist for SIs: network boundaries, data flow, credentials handling, and any shared infra. keep it 1 page.
Alex Kim: great. let's split: Rebecca = SOC2 + attestation text, Mike = pen-test timeline + vendor shortlist, Sara = ingest + presign, Jordan = SI questionnaire + disclosure blurb. i'll draft the intro and roles.
Rebecca Liu: SOC note: current report expires 2026-07-15. we must require renewed report before final marketplace publish. short attestation snippet i propose: "We maintain SOC2 Type II for our hosted control plane; Dedicated/Private deployments are covered via client-specific attestations — contact partnership-security@redwood.ai for clarifications."
Mike O'Connor: vendor shortlist: SecCheck Labs, RedPen, NightScan. prefer SecCheck for marketplace listings — they've done infra + app testing for similar partners. tentative window: 2026-05-11 -> 2026-05-22.
Sara Patel: presign details: propose bucket redwood-marketplace-evidence-prod, path: /partners/{partner_name}/{listing_id}/{artifact_type}/{timestamp}. example:
```
S3 path: s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence-prod/si-greystone/rlw-2026/pen-test/20260512-01.json
presign cmd: aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence-prod/si-greystone/rlw-2026/pen-test/20260512-01.json --expires-in 259200
```
Sara Patel: redaction checklist (short): remove PII, mask IPs, remove internal-only URLs, redact customer names, add attestation header with owner and TTL. owner must add a "redaction_notes.md" next to artifact.
Jordan Lee: SI questionnaire items (sketch): 1) deployment model (hosted/dedicated/private) 2) network egress patterns 3) encryption at rest/in transit 4) credential handling 5) pen-test evidence (date/vendor/report) 6) SOC2 references 7) contact for clarifications. also include a short release blurb they can reuse for joint announcement.
ComplianceBot: Automated check: SOC2 expiry for "redwood-inference-hosted" = 2026-07-15. Reminder: start renewal outreach 90 days prior.
Alex Kim: can we add a brief section for 'allowed public disclosure' — one-liner partners/SI can post once launch is approved. keep legal-sounding but short.
Rebecca Liu: proposed disclosure line: "This integration leverages Redwood Inference's inference platform. Security and privacy practices are documented; customers should consult respective deployment terms." (legal to sign off)
Mike O'Connor: timeline proposal: draft playbook out by Mon 05/05, internal review Wed 05/07, vendor & SI kickoff Fri 05/09, pen-test window 05/11-05/22, final artifacts due 06/01. any blockers?
Jordan Lee: need an ack from partner PM on ownership for artifact uploads and NDA timeframe. i'll ping Greystone PM now. @Alex Kim can you share partner PM contact?
Alex Kim: pinged in DM. greystone pm is kim_t@greystone.com. Jordan pls loop me when you have confirmation.
Sara Patel: also need a small script snippet for partners to upload and attach metadata. i'll draft and attach to playbook. example metadata keys: partner_name, listing_id, artifact_type, owner, redaction_done:true
Alex Kim: awesome. next steps: each owner adds a one-paragraph section to the playbook doc in the partnership drive by Mon COB (1799991600). i'll compile and circulate to legal + security. thanks team :thumbsup:
Rebecca Liu: noted. i'll attach attestation + short FAQ.
Mike O'Connor: i'll ping SecCheck for tentative slot.
Jordan Lee: pinged Greystone PM — awaiting reply.
ComplianceBot: Action logged: new playbook draft created by Alex Kim; review requested from Security and Legal.
